docs.title: Welcome to Iron Jetpacks Wiki
docs.text: This is the Un-official documentation for the Iron Jetpacks mod.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Welcome to the Iron Jetpacks mod! This mod adds a variety of jetpacks to help you navigate your world with ease.

docs.title: Keybindings
docs.text: By default, the jetpack is controlled using specific keys. You can change these in the Minecraft settings under Controls Key Binds.

docs.title: CurseForge Installation
docs.text:
1. Create or use a modpack that's on Minecraft 26.1-26.1.2 and Fabric 19.2 (not strictly 19.2; other versions compatible with Minecraft 26.1-26.1.2 will likely work perfectly fine).
  2. Press the Gray "+ Add Content" button below the Orange play button and search for "Iron Jetpacks(Port)". The mod should appear. Mod Curseforge
  3. Press install on the mod and it should install automatically with all required dependencies!
  4. Launch the game and enjoy!

docs.title: Manual Installation
docs.text:
1. Install Fabric Loader.
  2. Place the Iron Jetpacks .jar file in your mods folder.
  3. Install the required dependency mods:
    • TechReborn-6.0.4.jar
    • Fabric-Api-0.150.0+26.1.2.jar
    • fzzy_config-0.7.6+26.1.jar
    • fabric-language-kotlin-1.13.11+kotlin.2.3.21.jar
  4. Install recommended mods:
    • jei-26.1.2-fabric-29.6.2.31.jar
    • ModMenu-18.0.0-alpha.8.jar
  5. Launch the game and enjoy!

[!NOTE] The specific file names and versions listed above are just the developer's chosen tested versions. The most updated versions available for the 26.1-26.1.2 cycle will likely work perfectly fine!

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text: Frequently asked questions.

docs.title: How do I craft Coils?
docs.text: Coils are crafted using Redstone and a specific material (like Iron or Gold). You can find the exact recipes for each coil tier on the Coils Recipe Page.

docs.title: How do I craft Jetpacks?
docs.text: Jetpacks require a Strap, a Capacitor, two Thrusters, and the base material of the tier. To see the specific layout and components for each tier, visit the Jetpacks Index and select your desired tier!

docs.title: How do I craft Straps?
docs.text: Straps are used to assemble the final jetpack. They are crafted using Leather and Iron Nuggets. You can view the layout on the Straps Recipe Page.

docs.title: How do I craft Thrusters?
docs.text: Thrusters are the primary propulsion units for flight. They are crafted using materials specific to their tier, along with a coil. Find the exact patterns on the Thrusters Recipe Page.

docs.title: How do I craft Cells and Capacitors?
docs.text: Cells and Capacitors are essential power storage components. They follow similar patterns across all tiers using basic materials and Redstone. Check the Cells Recipe Page and Capacitors Recipe Page for details.

docs.title: How do I Power my Jetpack?
docs.text: You will need to generate power using TechReborn generators and transfer it via cables. For a complete guide on processing rubber, crafting generators, and connecting them to your jetpack, check out the Power Section! Mod Wiki

docs.title: Power Overview
docs.text:
Welcome to the Power section of the Iron Jetpacks Wiki. Here you will learn how to generate, store, and transfer the power needed to keep your jetpacks fueled for flight!

Since Iron Jetpacks run on Energy (E), we utilize TechReborn mechanics to establish a robust power grid. Mod Wiki

docs.title: Sections
docs.text:
• Rubber: The foundational material for creating cables and electrical components. Learn how to harvest sap and smelt it into rubber.
  • Cables: Learn how to craft and use different tiers of cables to transfer power efficiently without loss.
  • Generators: Explore the machine progression, from simple machine frames to fully-fledged power generators.
  • Usage: A visual guide on how to connect your generators, battery boxes, and jetpacks correctly.

docs.title: Cables
docs.text: Cables are essential for transferring Energy (E) from your generators and battery boxes into your Jetpack. Different cable tiers support different energy transfer rates. To prevent power loss, always use Insulated Cables!

docs.title: Generators
docs.text: Power generation is critical for fueling your Jetpacks. Iron Jetpacks supports the TechReborn power ecosystem, allowing you to build and upgrade machines to produce Energy (E).

docs.title: Machine Progression
docs.text:
The foundation of all TechReborn generators is the Basic Machine Frame.

  • Basic Machine Frame

docs.title: The Generator
docs.text:
Once you have the necessary components, you can craft the main Generator. This machine burns solid fuels (like Coal) to produce Energy (E).

  • Red Cell Battery
  • Solid Fuel Generator

Connect the Generator to a Battery Box using Cables to store your generated energy!

docs.title: Rubber
docs.text: Rubber is a core crafting material for almost all electrical components and cables. It is obtained by harvesting Sap from Rubber Trees and smelting it.

docs.title: Rubber Trees
docs.text:
Rubber Trees spawn naturally in the world. They can be identified by their distinctive wood and the Sap spots that form on their logs.

  • Rubber Sapling
  • Rubber Log
  • Rubber Log (Sap)

docs.title: Sap & Treetaps
docs.text:
When you find a Rubber Log with a Sap spot on it, you can harvest the Sap using a Treetap.

  • Sap
  • Treetap

Right-click the Sap spot with a Treetap to extract the Sap. The spot will eventually regenerate, providing an infinite source of Sap.

docs.title: Smelting Sap into Rubber
docs.text: Once you have gathered enough Sap, you can smelt it in a standard Furnace to produce Rubber.

docs.title: Power Usage
docs.text: Once you have established your power generation, you need to store and utilize it effectively to charge your Jetpack. Mod Wiki

docs.title: Connecting Machines
docs.text:
Generators produce power, but they should be connected to a Battery Box for storage. Use Cables to bridge the machines.

[!WARNING] Ensure to connect to any side of the Battery Box and not the Front as only the Sides take in power and the Front outputs it!

docs.title: Interface & Storage
docs.text: The Generator interface allows you to insert solid fuels to continuously produce energy.

docs.title: Charging your Jetpack
docs.text: To charge your Jetpack, place it into the Battery Box interface. It will rapidly draw the stored Energy (E).
